summary: Iteration 4: Tested Phase 5 — Provider-App Webhook Bridge. Backend: 21/22 pytest tests passed in /app/backend/tests/test_webhook_bridge.py covering HMAC-SHA256 signature validation (missing/bad → 401 + 'invalid_signature' rejected event logged), event processing (provider.signed_up → verified, provider.first_use → active, unsupported event → 400, missing phone → 400), phone normalization (+91/spaces stripped, matches existing contact), territory round-robin (Delhi→Rohan Sales Rep, Bengaluru→Priya Sales Lead, unknown city Atlantis falls back to a sales rep/manager), activity insertion (category='webhook_sync' linked to contact), /api/admin/webhooks/events list (internal users 200 with {items,total,secret_configured:true}, provider 403), /api/admin/webhooks/test-send (Master Admin returns ok+signed_payload+signature, provider 403), and Rohan's /api/agent/dashboard total_leads increments when a Delhi lead is auto-created via webhook. Frontend: 100% playwright pass — Master Admin Webhook Bridge Panel renders, secret status green 'HMAC secret configured', empty-phone validation shows 'Phone is required', sending a signed webhook with event=provider.first_use & city=Delhi creates a new lead in stage=active, recent events refresh with a new 'test'-tagged row. Provider lands on /provider (no panel), Sales Rep Rohan lands on /agent (no panel) and is correctly redirected away from / so panel never reaches non-admin views.

minor.issue: Review_request states 'Sales rep/provider get 403' but the implementation guards with require_internal (server.py:2108), which includes sales_rep. Sales rep Rohan can successfully call this endpoint and create leads (verified: returned 200 with full signed_payload + signature). Provider correctly gets 403. Either tighten the dep to is_admin_or_manager / master-only, or update the spec. Same applies to GET /api/admin/webhooks/events — sales reps can list all webhook events including ones for leads not assigned to them (potential PII over-exposure).

action_items: Tighten /api/admin/webhooks/test-send and /api/admin/webhooks/events to admin/manager only (or master-only) so sales reps cannot trigger lead creation or view the full webhook stream. Replace Depends(require_internal) with a new require_admin_or_manager / require_master check OR explicitly raise 403 inside the handler when user.role == 'sales_rep' and not is_master_admin.

Fix the un-related PAGEERROR: AxiosError that surfaces when a provider user lands on /provider (visible in this run's provider login — likely an unrelated 403 swallow gap, pre-existing — see iter-3 action item for the AgentDashboard 403 overlay).
Minor: prior iteration_3 action item (Add internalOnly to the /agent route guard in App.js:69) is STILL OPEN — providers visiting /agent still won't redirect. Out-of-scope for Phase 5 but unfixed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2295 lines — auth, contacts, agent, provider, webhooks, sync, seed all in one file. Strongly recommend splitting routers (auth.py, agent.py, provider.py, webhooks.py, admin.py, seed.py) before Phase 6.

/api/webhooks/provider-app does a full contacts collection scan (`async for c in db.contacts.find({}, {'_id': 0}): if _normalize_phone(c.phone) == phone_norm`) — O(N) per webhook. For 182 contacts it's fine; at 10k+ contacts this will get slow. Suggest storing a `phone_norm` field on contacts (computed at insert/update time) with a unique sparse index so matching becomes O(1).

The test-send endpoint (server.py:2107-2222) duplicates ~75 lines of business logic from provider_app_webhook (server.py:1962-2088). DRY violation: extract a shared `_process_provider_event(body_obj)` helper and call it from both, instead of two parallel branches.

ProviderWebhookBody.provider is typed as Dict[str,Any] — no Pydantic validation of phone/name/city. Consider a nested ProviderInfo Pydantic model so bad payloads fail fast at parse time rather than via the manual 'provider.phone is required' check.

Round-robin counter doc is keyed by lowercased city in db.webhook_counters — uses _id as the bucket name. If a new agent is added mid-cycle, the modulo index may briefly assign the same agent twice; not a correctness bug but worth a comment.
WebhookBridgePanel.jsx Field component lives at the bottom of the same file — fine but consider moving to /lib/ui or using existing shadcn Input for consistency with the rest of the app.

rca of the issue: Spec said '/api/admin/webhooks/test-send by Master Admin processes a mock event...Sales rep/provider get 403' but server.py:2108 uses `current=Depends(require_internal)` which evaluates `is_internal(user) = user.role in INTERNAL_ROLES or is_master_admin` and INTERNAL_ROLES includes 'sales_rep'. Hence sales rep Rohan (role=sales_rep, is_master_admin=False) passes the dep and gets 200 instead of the expected 403. This grants every sales rep the ability to (a) view the entire firm-wide webhook event stream including leads not assigned to them and (b) trigger creation of leads in any city via the test-send endpoint, bypassing normal lead assignment policy. Fix: introduce `require_admin_or_manager` (or reuse is_admin_or_manager()) on these two endpoints, OR add an explicit `if current.get('role') == 'sales_rep' and not current.get('is_master_admin'): raise HTTPException(403)` guard. Reproduction: log in as 9000000002/Trata@123, POST /api/admin/webhooks/test-send with body {event:'provider.signed_up', phone:'<unique>', city:'Delhi'} → 200 with full signed_payload.
